title: Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST - Arakawa Hiromu Kaki Oroshi 4-koma Gekijou
justification: AniList 7902 (SPECIAL, 16 episode(s) from 2009-08-26) is AniDB 6107's special(s) S6-S21, aired 2009-08-26 to 2010-11-24. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 6107. The parent's row start 2 end 21 offset -1 puts S6-S21 on TVDB 0x5-0x20 'Four Panel Comic Theater' episodes (same dates).
